title: {{vocab.firm}}: how a {{vocab.payment}} earns trust
subtitle: Your {{cast.agent}} earns more trust as the risk and the amount rise. Each rung needs its own proof.

rungs.name: Signed in
rungs.needs: A sign-in proof from {{cast.provider}}, fresh for one hour.

rungs.name: Step-up satisfied
rungs.needs: A fresh step-up check (5 minutes). {{vocab.payments}} up to 600.

rungs.name: CIBA approved
rungs.needs: An approval from the {{vocab.approver}}, single use, 2 minutes. {{vocab.payments}} up to 1000.

ui.phoneNote: This stands in for {{cast.approver}}. It is the only place a request is approved or denied.

outcome.approved: The {{vocab.approver}} approved. Rung 3: send the {{vocab.payment}} now.
outcome.denied: The {{vocab.approver}} denied the request. The {{vocab.payment}} stays refused.
outcome.approval_expired: The approval window ended before the {{vocab.payment}} was sent.
